# Noor Quran & Hadith

> Multilingual Quran and Hadith learning platform with grounded citations, authenticated tafsir context, and guided discovery.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Main Quran and Hadith discovery hub.
- [Search](/search): Advanced multilingual Quran search.
- [Ask](/ask): Ask questions and get verse-grounded answers.
- [Learn](/learn): Explore Quran entities by topics, prophets, stories, and themes.
- [Tafsir Ibn Kathir Guide](/learn/tafsir-ibn-kathir): Practical guide to studying Ibn Kathir with source discipline.
- [Emotions](/emotions): Emotion-centered Quran verse exploration.
- [Topics](/topics): Thematic Quran index.
- [Prophets](/prophets): Prophets in the Quran with verse references.
- [Plans](/plans): Structured Quran reading plans.
- [Surah 1](/surah/1): Representative Surah reading page.
- [Hadith](/hadith): Hadith knowledge browsing and search.
- [Knowledge Hadith](/knowledge/hadith): Hadith knowledge center overview.
- [Kids Zone](/kids): Quran quizzes, rewards, and guided learning for children.
- [Research](/research): Deeper grounded Quran research workspace.

## Optional

- [Explore Timeline](/explore/timeline): Quran discovery timeline view.
- [Explore Map](/explore/map): Quran places exploration map.
- [Learn Journeys](/learn/journeys): Guided learning journey paths.
